title: 15,000 in 15 Minutes! BEST New MOB Farm for Minecraft 1.21/26.1+!
description: In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to build a new mob farm that takes advantage of game mechanics to use water as both a clock and a pushing system over all floors for the farm, making this farm an absolute monster, while it doesn't use a single redstone, making this farm the easiest, cheapest, but fastest mob farm you can make for Minecraft!
detailedDescription:
🧱 Farm Performance : ~+700 to 22,000 Per Hour! (The rate depends on the level of looting enchantment you are using and the difficulty of your game.)

🔨 Farm Mode : Fully Automatic
